issue.body:
- [x] `router.generate` takes an array like `['/foo', { id: 3 }, 'bar', {post: 4}]` and returns a URL.
  - [ ] for now, each URL must start with `./` (child), `/` (root), or `..` (parent) – later we can implement a sane default behavior for segments with no prefix
- [x] `router-link` directive uses router.generate API
- [ ] Exception thrown when route not found (see #2323)
- [ ] Ability to link to route params for the current route without affecting children: `[router-link] = "[{ order: 'asc' }]"`
